name: blur-fade
title: Blur Fade
description: Fades content in out of a blur, from any direction, on mount or when it scrolls into view.

variants.name: slide-in
variants.title: Slide in
variants.description: Slides in from the left over a long distance while it fades.

variants.name: heavy-blur
variants.title: Heavy blur
variants.description: Resolves from a very strong blur with no movement.

name: chromatic-text-reveal
title: Chromatic Text Reveal
description: A sentence whose last word is painted in by a moving, colored edge, then swapped for the next.

variants.name: play-once
variants.title: Play once
variants.description: Paints each word in a single time and stops on the last one.

name: scroll-text-reveal
title: Scroll Text Reveal
description: A paragraph whose words light up one by one as it scrolls up the screen. Shows all the text under reduced motion.

name: split-reveal
title: Split Reveal
description: Words or letters rise out of their own masks and sharpen from a blur, on mount or scroll into view.

variants.name: letters
variants.title: Letters
variants.description: Reveals the text one letter at a time instead of word by word.

props.text: Every letter lands on its own.

variants.name: sharp-words
variants.title: Sharp words
variants.description: Words rise out of a mask with no blur at all.

props.text: Clean edges from the very first frame.

name: typing-animation
title: Typing Animation
description: Types text out character by character, optionally deleting and cycling through words. Screen readers get the full text up front.

variants.name: block-cursor
variants.title: Block cursor
variants.description: Types and deletes several phrases with a solid terminal block cursor.

variants.name: quick-no-cursor
variants.title: Quick, no cursor
variants.description: Types one line very fast with the cursor hidden.

props.children: Typed in a blink, with no cursor in sight.

name: morphing-text
title: Morphing Text
description: Melts one word into the next with a blur and an SVG threshold filter. Screen readers get the whole list once.

variants.name: slow-morph
variants.title: Slow morph
variants.description: Long, gentle morphs that linger between words.

name: word-rotate
title: Word Rotate
description: Swaps one word for the next with a short slide and fade. Screen readers get the whole list once.

variants.name: rapid
variants.title: Rapid
variants.description: Swaps words every second with a snappy transition.

name: number-ticker
title: Number Ticker
description: Counts a number up or down with a soft ease once it scrolls into view. Screen readers get the final value.

variants.name: countdown
variants.title: Countdown
variants.description: Counts down from the value to a lower start number.

variants.name: currency
variants.title: Currency
variants.description: A slow count to a two-decimal amount with German number formatting.

name: odometer
title: Odometer
description: A number on mechanical digit wheels that roll to their new faces whenever the value changes. Formats with Intl, so currency and grouping just work.

name: rolling-text
title: Rolling Text
description: Rolls every letter up and swaps it for a copy of itself, on hover, mount or scroll into view.

variants.name: on-mount
variants.title: On mount
variants.description: Rolls the letters once as soon as the text appears.

name: split-flap-text
title: Split Flap Text
description: Departure-board lettering. Tiles flip through a drum of letters on a hinge, one beat apart. Screen readers get the lines once.

variants.name: rapid-board
variants.title: Rapid board
variants.description: A departures board that flips quickly through city names.

name: line-shadow-text
title: Line Shadow Text
description: Text with a hatched, diagonal-lined shadow that slowly slides behind it. The hatching holds still under reduced motion.

name: perspective-text
title: Perspective Text
description: Words or lines stacked in depth on a plane that tilts towards the cursor. Sits at a calm fixed angle under reduced motion.

name: scramble-text
title: Scramble Text
description: Letters cycle through random glyphs and decode into the real text, on mount, hover or scroll into view.

variants.name: hover-decode
variants.title: Hover decode
variants.description: Scrambles and decodes the text each time you hover it.

variants.name: binary
variants.title: Binary
variants.description: A slow decode through zeros and ones only.

name: shine-text
title: Shine Text
description: A band of light glides across the text on a loop, like polished metal catching a lamp.

name: sparkles-text
title: Sparkles Text
description: Text with little four-point stars that twinkle in and out around it. The stars hold still under reduced motion.

name: spinning-text
title: Spinning Text
description: Letters set around a circle that turns forever, in either direction. Holds still under reduced motion.

name: spoiler-text
title: Spoiler Text
description: Text hidden under a shimmering field of specks. Click or press Enter to blow them away and read it. Screen readers hear a spoiler button until it opens.

name: wave-text
title: Wave Text
description: A gentle wave rolls through the letters, each one a beat behind its neighbour.

variants.name: big-wave
variants.title: Big wave
variants.description: Tall, quick swells that travel across each letter.

name: shader-background
title: Shader Background
description: A soft, flowing noise field drawn by a raw WebGL shader in your theme colors. Sleeps off screen, falls back to a CSS gradient.

name: dot-field
title: Dot Field
description: A halftone of dots on a springy membrane. A swipe drags the dots and a click sends a ring through them.

name: flickering-grid
title: Flickering Grid
description: A grid of small squares that blink between dim and bright on a canvas. Stills under reduced motion and rests off screen.

name: flow-field
title: Flow Field
description: Wind drawn as streamlines on a canvas. The cursor is a disc the air flows around. Rests off screen and stills under reduced motion.

name: glyph-matrix
title: Glyph Matrix
description: A grid of monospace glyphs where a few cells at a time swap character and brightness. Fades towards the bottom and stills under reduced motion.

name: halftone-background
title: Halftone Background
description: A halftone print on a canvas: a rotated screen of dots sized by the ink a lit sphere takes, with a light that circles it or follows the cursor.

variants.name: coarse-newsprint
variants.title: Coarse newsprint
variants.description: Big, widely spaced dots at a shallow screen angle, like cheap newsprint.

variants.name: fine-still
variants.title: Fine and still
variants.description: A tight, fine screen with the light held in place.

name: meteors
title: Meteors
description: Streaks of light that fall across the parent box. Decorative, deterministic, still under reduced motion.

variants.name: shower
variants.title: Shower
variants.description: A dense, fast shower of short meteors.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border

variants.name: slanted
variants.title: Slanted
variants.description: A few slow meteors leaning right instead of left.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border

name: particles
title: Particles
description: Specks of light drifting across a canvas that lean towards the cursor. Rests off screen and stills under reduced motion.

name: topo-background
title: Topo Background
description: A drifting topographic map: contour lines traced through a noise terrain on a canvas, with a hill that rises under the cursor.

variants.name: dense-contours
variants.title: Dense contours
variants.description: Closely packed contour lines on a different terrain.

variants.name: still-relief
variants.title: Still relief
variants.description: Widely spaced contours on frozen terrain that ignores the cursor.

name: diagonal-hatch
title: Diagonal Hatch
description: Fine diagonal hatching that fades towards the edges, like a sketch shaded with a ruler.

variants.name: left-lean
variants.title: Left lean
variants.description: Tight lines leaning left that run to the edges without fading.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background

variants.name: wide-bold
variants.title: Wide and bold
variants.description: Widely spaced, heavy lines.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background

name: dot-grid
title: Dot Grid
description: A dot grid with a fine grain and soft edges. Dots near the cursor take the primary color and grow.

variants.name: dense-flat
variants.title: Dense and flat
variants.description: Tight, fine dots across the whole box, with no fade, glow or grain.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border

variants.name: big-glow
variants.title: Big glow
variants.description: Large, sparse dots with a wide cursor glow.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border

name: graph-paper
title: Graph Paper
description: Engineering graph paper: fine squares with a stronger line every few cells, fading out towards the edges.

variants.name: fine-plain
variants.title: Fine and plain
variants.description: Small squares with no major lines and no fade.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background

variants.name: blueprint-fade
variants.title: Large fading down
variants.description: Large squares with a strong line every four cells, fading out towards the bottom.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background

name: hexagon-pattern
title: Hexagon Pattern
description: A honeycomb of hairline hexagons drawn as one repeating SVG pattern, with optional filled cells and an edge fade.

name: retro-grid
title: Retro Grid
description: A perspective grid that scrolls toward the viewer. Pure CSS 3D, no canvas. Decorative and still under reduced motion.

variants.name: steep-slow
variants.title: Steep and slow
variants.description: A steeply tilted floor of large cells rolling slowly.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background

variants.name: flat-fast
variants.title: Flat and fast
variants.description: A shallow tilt of small cells rushing past.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background

name: aurora-background
title: Aurora Background
description: A slow, blurred aurora drifting behind your content. Tinted from the primary token, paused off screen, still under reduced motion.

variants.name: vivid-fast
variants.title: Vivid and fast
variants.description: A bright aurora sweeping at three times the speed.

variants.name: faint-still
variants.title: Faint and still
variants.description: A barely-there aurora held perfectly still.

name: light-rays
title: Light Rays
description: Soft shafts of light that fade in, sway and fade out over two corner glows. Holds a still pose under reduced motion.

name: mesh-glow
title: Mesh Glow
description: Soft blurred glows over a fine grid with a calm vignette. Drifts slowly, or holds still.

variants.name: still-glow
variants.title: Still glow
variants.description: The glows held in place with no drift.

props.className: relative h-64 w-[28rem] max-w-full overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background

variants.name: fast-faint
variants.title: Fast and faint
variants.description: Dim glows that drift in a quick six-second cycle.

name: cursor-follow
title: Cursor Follow
description: Replaces the system cursor inside an area with a spring-smoothed bubble that grows into a text label over elements marked with data-cursor-text.

name: cursor-image-trail
title: Cursor Image Trail
description: Drops a pool of images or cards along the pointer's path inside an area, larger and longer-lived the faster you move.

variants.name: dense-small
variants.title: Dense and small
variants.description: Small, unrotated tiles drop every few pixels and vanish quickly.

variants.name: big-lazy
variants.title: Big and lazy
variants.description: Large, tilted tiles are spaced far apart and linger for over a second.

name: drawing-cursor
title: Drawing Cursor
description: The cursor leaves a smooth ink line on a click-through canvas that thins when you move fast and fades as it dries.

name: smooth-cursor
title: Smooth Cursor
description: Replaces the system cursor inside an area with a spring-smoothed arrow that turns toward the direction of travel.

variants.name: floaty
variants.title: Floaty
variants.description: A loose spring makes the cursor drift behind the pointer.

variants.name: snappy
variants.title: Snappy
variants.description: A stiff, heavily damped spring keeps the cursor almost glued to the pointer.

name: spotlight
title: Spotlight
description: A soft primary-tinted light that follows the pointer across a card, with an optional glow on the nearest edge.

variants.name: wide-glow
variants.title: Wide glow
variants.description: A huge, brighter glow that washes across the whole card.

variants.name: tight-beam
variants.title: Tight beam
variants.description: A small, bright spot with no border highlight.

name: magnetic
title: Magnetic
description: Pulls a button or icon toward the pointer on a spring when the cursor comes close.

variants.name: strong-pull
variants.title: Strong pull
variants.description: The element is drawn most of the way to the pointer from far away.

name: tilt-card
title: Tilt Card
description: A card that tilts toward the pointer in 3D on a spring, with an optional soft glare that follows the cursor.

variants.name: steep
variants.title: Steep
variants.description: The card leans up to 28 degrees toward the pointer.

variants.name: no-glare
variants.title: No glare
variants.description: The card tilts without the highlight following the pointer.

name: click-ripple
title: Click Ripple
description: Sends rings of the primary color out from every click inside an area, on a click-through layer. Off on touch screens and under reduced motion.

name: cool-mode
title: Cool Mode
description: Sprays coloured particles or emoji from the cursor while a button is pressed, drawn on a click-through canvas.

variants.name: confetti
variants.title: Confetti
variants.description: A big burst of party-popper emoji flies out on each press.

variants.name: gentle
variants.title: Gentle
variants.description: Only a few small circles drift out slowly.

name: bell-button
title: Bell Button
description: A notification toggle whose bell swings and rings when switched on, with an unread badge, and goes quiet with a slash when off.

name: clip-corners-button
title: Clip Corners Button
description: A tech-style button with shaved corners that cut deeper on hover and keyboard focus.

name: command-button
title: Command Button
description: A button that draws its keyboard shortcut as physical keycaps. The shortcut works page-wide: caps sink as keys go down and the button clicks on a match.

name: dot-morph-button
title: Dot Morph Button
description: A pill button whose leading dot springs into a tall bar on hover and keyboard focus. Stays a dot on touch screens and under reduced motion.

name: family-button
title: Family Button
description: A square button that springs open into a panel and collapses back. The toggle rotates from plus to close.

variants.name: open-wide
variants.title: Open and wide
variants.description: Starts open with a wider, shorter panel so the actions sit in a roomier tray.

name: shimmer-button
title: Shimmer Button
description: A button with a light that circles its edge. Stops when disabled or under reduced motion.

variants.name: wide-slow
variants.title: Wide and slow
variants.description: A thick band of light that takes eight seconds to circle the button.

variants.name: quick-glint
variants.title: Quick glint
variants.description: A thin, fast glint that loops every second.

name: slide-text-button
title: Slide Text Button
description: A button whose label slides up and is replaced by a second label on hover or keyboard focus. Renders as a button or a link.

variants.name: ghost
variants.title: Ghost
variants.description: A borderless button that slides its label up to reveal the hover text, with no filled background.

name: double-tap-button
title: Double Tap Button
description: A destructive action that needs two presses: the first arms it with a draining fuse, the second inside the window confirms. Waiting or blur disarms it.

name: hold-action-button
title: Hold Action Button
description: A button that confirms only after being held down, with a fill that rewinds on early release. Works with pointer and Space / Enter, announces completion, and completes without animation under reduced motion.

variants.name: quick-hold
variants.title: Quick hold
variants.description: Fills and confirms after only half a second of holding.

variants.name: long-hold
variants.title: Long hold
variants.description: Needs a deliberate four-second press before the action fires.

name: slide-to-confirm
title: Slide to Confirm
description: A slide-to-commit control for irreversible actions: drag the thumb to the end, or press Enter, Space or the right arrow. Shows busy and done states.

name: undo-button
title: Undo Button
description: A button that acts at once, then holds the real commit back for a short undo window with a draining bar and a Ctrl/Cmd+Z shortcut.

name: morph-toggle
title: Morph Toggle
description: A switch with a spring thumb that can morph from a rounded square to a circle, or carry an icon that turns as it flips.

name: theme-switch
title: Theme Switch
description: A sun and moon switch: a sliding mask bites the sun into a crescent while its rays fold away. Reports the theme and leaves applying it to you.

name: folder-reveal
title: Folder Reveal
description: A folder that fans its cards out when opened: the flap tips forward and the cards rise and spread, on hover, click or keyboard.

name: hover-swap-card
title: Hover Swap Card
description: A card that swaps its title and visual and lifts the media on hover or keyboard focus. Pure CSS transitions.

name: shift-card
title: Shift Card
description: A card whose bottom panel grows over the middle content on hover, focus or click, swapping what the top shows.

name: card-flip
title: Card Flip
description: A card that turns over on a spring to show its back, on click, Enter or Space, or optionally while a mouse hovers it.

name: photo-stack
title: Photo Stack
description: A deck of offset cards. Click, press Enter or Space, or drag the top card to send it to the back and reveal the next.

name: time-machine-stack
title: Time Machine Stack
description: A stack that reaches back through time: older cards peek out above the front one, and Newer, Older or the arrow keys step through them.

name: border-beam
title: Border Beam
description: A light that travels around the border of its parent card. Decorative, follows the parent's radius.

variants.name: bold-fast
variants.title: Bold and fast
variants.description: A large, thick comet that laps the card edge in three seconds.

variants.name: slow-reverse
variants.title: Slow reverse
variants.description: A small light that drifts counter-clockwise, taking twelve seconds per lap.

name: emboss-surface
title: Emboss Surface
description: A surface carved by light: raised, pressed in or stamped, with the relief following a light angle you set or the pointer. Can carve just the text.

name: glass-card
title: Glass Card
description: A frosted glass pane with blurred backdrop, a polished rim and a specular highlight that follows the pointer.

name: glow-hover-card
title: Glow Hover Cards
description: A grid of cards lit by one shared glow: borders and fills light up under the pointer and carry across neighbouring cards.

name: holographic-foil
title: Holographic Foil
description: A card with a holographic foil layer: theme-colored bands shift and a glare slides across as the pointer moves.

name: texture-card
title: Texture Card
description: A card framed by nested hairline borders for a machined, tactile edge. Ships header, title, description, content, footer and separator parts.

name: card-field
title: Card Field
description: A one-row card input for checkout. The number groups by brand, then slides away to its last four digits to make room for expiry and security code.

name: float-input
title: Float Input
description: A text field whose label starts inside the box and floats up when you focus or type.

name: otp-boxed-input
title: OTP Boxed Input
description: A one-time-code field of separate boxes with paste, arrow-key navigation, error state and a resend countdown.

name: detent-dial
title: Detent Dial
description: A rotary knob that clicks from notch to notch, with a swelling tick ring, flick momentum and a rolling readout.

name: liquid-slider
title: Liquid Slider
description: A glass of water you fill by dragging its surface. The liquid sloshes and bubbles; under reduced motion it just rises.

name: scrubber
title: Scrubber
description: A horizontal value scrubber: drag across a labelled track to set a number, with tick marks and a capsule thumb.

name: duration-picker
title: Duration Picker
description: Hours, minutes and seconds as separate segments you type into, step with the keyboard or scrub by dragging, with rolling digits.

name: week-strip-calendar
title: Week Strip Calendar
description: A one-week date strip: step between weeks with the arrows and tap a day to select it.

name: wheel-picker
title: Wheel Picker
description: An iOS-style drum picker: real 3D cylinders you drag, flick, scroll or step with the keyboard.

name: dimple-switch
title: Dimple Switch
description: A chunky physical-looking switch: a dimpled knob slides along an inset track.

name: segmented-toggle-button
title: Segmented Toggle Button
description: An iOS-style segmented control with a pill that slides under the active label.

name: tip-selector
title: Tip Selector
description: A checkout tip picker set on a draggable tape with preset chips, a Round up shortcut and rolling totals.

name: file-upload
title: File Upload
description: A drop zone with an upload queue: drop, paste or browse, watch progress per file, cancel or retry. Simulated locally unless you pass onUpload.

name: signature-pad
title: Signature Pad
description: A canvas to sign on with mouse, touch or pen. Ink is sprung and thins with speed; the result comes out as SVG.

name: collab-toolbar
title: Collab Toolbar
description: A floating toolbar of icon buttons and a collaborator avatar stack, split into groups by dividers.

name: dock
title: Dock
description: A row of icons that swell as the pointer approaches, macOS style. Stays at rest on touch and under reduced motion.

variants.name: big-swell
variants.title: Big swell
variants.description: Small resting icons that swell to more than twice their size over a wide reach.

variants.name: centered
variants.title: Centered growth
variants.description: Icons grow outward from the middle of the dock instead of rising from the bottom edge.

name: fluid-hover-highlight
title: Fluid Hover Highlight
description: One highlight that glides between list rows under the pointer or keyboard focus instead of blinking on hover.

name: kebab-actions-dropdown
title: Kebab Actions Dropdown
description: A row with a kebab button that expands its action menu inside the same card, with arrow-key navigation.

name: marking-menu
title: Marking Menu
description: A radial menu you open by holding, flicking or right-clicking a surface, with a keyboard path through a Menu button.

name: morph-surface
title: Morph Surface
description: A small pill that morphs into a feedback form and back, with a shared dot and a check on success.

name: profile-dropdown
title: Profile Dropdown
description: An account menu that grows out of its own trigger, with status, theme, links, account switching and a hold-to-confirm sign out.

name: breadcrumb
title: Breadcrumb
description: A breadcrumb trail whose items slide in one after another. Marks the last item as the current page.

name: direction-aware-tabs
title: Direction Aware Tabs
description: Tabs whose panel slides in from the side you are moving towards, with a sliding pill and an animated panel height.

name: linen-tab-button
title: Linen Tab Button
description: A button with a woven linen face, dashed stitching and a soft lift on press.

name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page navigation with ellipses and a sliding indicator behind the active page.

name: bounce-sidebar
title: Bounce Sidebar
description: A vertical nav with a dot that hops along a curved path to the selected item.

name: sidebar
title: Sidebar
description: A collapsible app rail that animates between full width and an icon rail, with menu buttons and a trigger.

name: action-search-bar
title: Action Search Bar
description: A command palette in a search bar: fuzzy search, nested pages, recent rows, shortcut hints and in-row progress.

name: favicon-search
title: Favicon Search
description: A search field with a keyboard-driven result list that shows an icon, title and description per row.

name: search-input
title: Search Input
description: A search field with a leading icon, a clear button, a hint and an error state.

name: modal-dialog
title: Modal Dialog
description: A centered modal with focus trap, Escape, scroll lock and focus return, plus an alertdialog mode for confirmations. Fades without motion under reduced motion.

name: sheet-drawer
title: Sheet Drawer
description: A panel that slides in from the right, left or bottom over a dimmed page, with focus trap and Escape. The bottom sheet drags down to dismiss; no slide under reduced motion.

name: morph-popover
title: Morph Popover
description: A button that morphs into a small feedback form, its label becoming the panel title. Escape or an outside click folds it back; it swaps without morphing under reduced motion.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: A short label for a control that shows on hover and keyboard focus, wired with aria-describedby. Escape hides it; it only fades under reduced motion.

name: lens
title: Lens
description: A round magnifying lens that follows the pointer over any content. Mouse and trackpad only: touch screens and reduced motion get the plain content. The magnified copy is hidden from assistive tech.

variants.name: loupe
variants.title: Loupe
variants.description: A small lens at triple zoom for reading the finest print.

variants.name: wide-lens
variants.title: Wide lens
variants.description: A large, gentle lens that covers a third of the card at a mild zoom.

name: lightbox-grid
title: Lightbox Grid
description: A grid of tiles that opens into a full-screen viewer with previous/next, arrow keys, Escape and a focus trap. Opens without scaling under reduced motion.

name: blur-scrim
title: Blur Scrim
description: A blur-and-dim layer that covers its container instead of the page, with content centred on top. Click or Escape dismisses it; no fade under reduced motion.

name: progressive-blur
title: Progressive Blur
description: A gradual blur over the edge of a scrolling area, built from stacked backdrop-filter layers. Decorative and static.

variants.name: top-fade
variants.title: Top edge
variants.description: Blurs only the top edge, as under a sticky header.

variants.name: deep-bottom
variants.title: Deep bottom
variants.description: A tall bottom blur that fades about a third of the list into haze.

name: animated-list
title: Animated List
description: Adds its children one at a time, newest on top, with a springy push. Shows everything at once under reduced motion.

variants.name: rapid
variants.title: Rapid feed
variants.description: Items arrive about three times faster and the feed keeps looping.

variants.name: play-once
variants.title: Play once
variants.description: Items arrive after a short delay and the list stops on the last one instead of looping.

name: hover-image-list
title: Hover Image List
description: A text list that reveals a preview for the row you point at; the preview trails the cursor on desktop and sits beside the list on touch, with focus and reduced motion.

name: pinned-list
title: Pinned List
description: A list where any row can be pinned. Pinned rows rise to the top and the others close the gap with a spring; rows jump under reduced motion.

name: coverflow-carousel
title: Coverflow Carousel
description: A 3D coverflow where the centre slide faces front and its neighbours tilt away. Drag, buttons and arrow keys; flat and fading under reduced motion.

name: drag-carousel
title: Drag Carousel
description: A free-scrolling row of slides with elastic drag, plus arrow-key and button stepping.

variants.name: peek-strip
variants.title: Peek strip
variants.description: Narrow, tightly packed slides with no buttons, so the row is moved by dragging alone.

variants.name: wide-slides
variants.title: Wide slides
variants.description: Large slides with generous gaps, so only one and a half fit in view.

name: image-accordion
title: Image Accordion
description: A row of image panels where one is wide and the rest are slim. The open panel follows hover, focus or click and reveals its title.

variants.name: click
variants.title: Click to open
variants.description: Panels open only on click or focus, so a passing pointer changes nothing.

name: thumbnail-carousel
title: Thumbnail Carousel
description: A swipeable slide with a thumbnail strip underneath. The active thumbnail widens and the strip glides to centre it.

variants.name: banner
variants.title: Banner
variants.description: A low, wide slide above the thumbnail strip, like a hero banner.

variants.name: tall
variants.title: Tall
variants.description: A tall slide that gives each photo a portrait-like frame.

name: smooth-accordion
title: Smooth Accordion
description: A stack of disclosures with panels that grow to their content, single or multiple mode, and full keyboard navigation.

variants.name: multiple
variants.title: Multiple open
variants.description: Several panels can stay open at once, two of them open first.

items.title: What is Mozaik?
items.content: A collection of small, hand-finished React components. Copy one into your project and own the source.

items.title: How do I add a component?
items.content: Copy the source from its page and install the npm packages it lists. The file is yours to edit.

items.title: Does it respect reduced motion?
items.content: Yes. Every animation turns into a calm, static frame when the user prefers reduced motion.

variants.name: always-open
variants.title: Always open
variants.description: One panel is always open, so the open header cannot be closed again.

items.title: What is Mozaik?
items.content: A collection of small, hand-finished React components. Copy one into your project and own the source.

items.title: How do I add a component?
items.content: Copy the source from its page and install the npm packages it lists. The file is yours to edit.

items.title: Does it respect reduced motion?
items.content: Yes. Every animation turns into a calm, static frame when the user prefers reduced motion.

name: marquee
title: Marquee
description: Endless horizontal or vertical loop of any content, with pause on hover and a still frame under reduced motion.

variants.name: vertical
variants.title: Vertical
variants.description: The text loop scrolls upward inside a fixed-height box.

props.children: Copy it. Paste it. Own it.

variants.name: reverse
variants.title: Reverse
variants.description: The text loop runs left to right and pauses on hover.

props.children: Quiet motion. Tokens first. Reduced motion is a first-class state.

name: orbiting-circles
title: Orbiting Circles
description: Spreads its children around a ring and walks them around it. Items stay upright and rest under reduced motion.

variants.name: counter-clockwise
variants.title: Counter-clockwise
variants.description: One ring of icons that circles against the clock on a tight orbit.

variants.name: fast-swarm
variants.title: Fast swarm
variants.description: Small icons race around a wide orbit with no ring drawn, about three times faster.

name: scroll-velocity-marquee
title: Scroll Velocity Marquee
description: A marquee that crawls on its own and speeds up or reverses with how fast the page scrolls. Pauses off screen and stays still under reduced motion.

name: animated-beam
title: Animated Beam
description: A light that flows along a curved path between two elements, for integration diagrams. Holds a still path under reduced motion and pauses off screen.

name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: Container-responsive bento grid with cards that lift on hover, move their artwork and follow the pointer with a soft glow.

variants.name: two-columns
variants.title: Two columns
variants.description: A wider two-column grid with tall rows, so each tile gets room for its artwork.

variants.name: four-columns
variants.title: Four columns
variants.description: A dense four-column grid with short rows that packs the same tiles into a tighter mosaic.

name: shuffle-grid
title: Shuffle Grid
description: A grid whose tiles glide to new places when shuffled or reset. Tiles jump instead under reduced motion.

name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll Progress
description: A thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or any scroll container.

name: svg-draw-on-scroll
title: SVG Draw on Scroll
description: SVG strokes that draw themselves as the element scrolls through view, one path after another. Fully drawn under reduced motion.

name: scroll-image-reveal
title: Scroll Image Reveal
description: A frame that opens with a wipe, curtain or circle as it scrolls into view, with counter-parallax inside. Open and still under reduced motion.

name: scroll-reveal-paragraph
title: Scroll Reveal Paragraph
description: A paragraph whose words go from faint to full strength one by one as it scrolls into view. Fully lit under reduced motion.

name: parallax-layers
title: Parallax Layers
description: A stack of layers that drift at different speeds as the scene scrolls past. Layers stay put under reduced motion.

name: orbit-loader
title: Orbit Loader
description: Dots circling on nested rings at different speeds. Under reduced motion it holds one evenly spread frame.

name: ring-spinner
title: Ring Spinner
description: A minimal indeterminate ring in three sizes that takes its color from the surrounding text.

variants.name: small
variants.title: Small
variants.description: A tiny ring with a fine stroke that fits inline next to text.

variants.name: large-slow
variants.title: Large, slow
variants.description: A large thick ring that turns slowly and calmly.

name: thinking-loader
title: Thinking Loader
description: A calm waiting indicator in three shapes (dots, bar, grid) that share one tempo and never fake progress.

variants.name: dots
variants.title: Dots
variants.description: Three dots that brighten in turn.

variants.name: bar
variants.title: Bar
variants.description: A short bar that slides across a track.

variants.name: grid
variants.title: Grid
variants.description: A three-by-three grid that pulses cell by cell.

name: shimmer-skeleton
title: Shimmer Skeleton
description: A placeholder block with a soft light sweeping across it. Wrap real content and it keeps the exact size.

variants.name: avatar
variants.title: Avatar
variants.description: A round placeholder with a light sweep, sized for a profile picture.

variants.name: card
variants.title: Card
variants.description: A large rounded block that stands in for an image or card.

name: skeleton-reveal
title: Skeleton Reveal
description: Wraps real content and swaps a placeholder for it with a cross-fade. The content is always laid out, so nothing shifts when it arrives.

name: progress-ring
title: Progress Ring
description: A determinate ring that eases to its value and counts up in the middle.

variants.name: thin-large
variants.title: Thin, large
variants.description: A large ring with a hairline stroke and the percentage in the middle.

variants.name: compact
variants.title: Compact
variants.description: A small bold ring with no number, for dense layouts.

name: stacked-meter
title: Stacked Meter
description: A capacity bar split into labelled parts, like storage by file type, with a legend that highlights each part and shows the free space.

name: step-progress
title: Step Progress
description: One progress bar cut into a segment per step with labels underneath. Finished steps are full, the current one fills as far as you say.

name: alert
title: Alert
description: An inline notice with an optional icon, title and body in four tones. Warnings and errors interrupt screen readers; info and success are polite.

name: animated-subscribe-button
title: Animated Subscribe Button
description: A toggle button whose label slides away and the next one drops in. A real button with aria-pressed, in controlled or uncontrolled form.

name: animated-toast-stack
title: Animated Toast Stack
description: A stack of toasts that spring in with a blur, swap their icon and text in place, swipe away and expire on a timer. Includes a hook to drive it.

name: notification-banner
title: Notification Banner
description: A small snackbar with a check icon, an optional action and a close button. Slides up, fades out on dismiss and leaves a button to bring it back.

name: notification-stack
title: Notification Stack
description: A pile of notifications that fans out on hover or focus. Swipe, click or press Delete to dismiss; the remaining cards close the gap.

name: speech-bubble
title: Speech Bubble
description: A pill-shaped chat bubble with a curved tail and a blinking caret. Calm and still under reduced motion.

name: announcement
title: Announcement
description: A pill that announces something new: a small tag followed by a title. Render it as a link to make the whole pill clickable.

name: count-badge
title: Count Badge
description: A badge for the corner of an avatar or icon: a dot, a rolling count with a cap, or a presence dot, with an optional pulse.

name: dynamic-island
title: Dynamic Island
description: A pill that springs open into richer views, in the style of the iPhone status island. The shell animates real size, so content is never distorted.

variants.name: incoming-call
variants.title: Incoming call
variants.description: The island sits open on a caller card with an avatar and a two-line label.

variants.name: timer
variants.title: Timer
variants.description: The island sits open on a large tabular countdown with a caption below.

name: empty-state
title: Empty State
description: A first-run or no-results state: an optional icon, a heading, a supporting sentence and an action.

name: radar-badge
title: Radar Badge
description: A live-monitoring badge: a tiny radar sweep with spreading rings next to a label, in live, scanning, idle and alert states.

variants.name: scanning
variants.title: Scanning
variants.description: A fast sweep without rings, in the primary color.

variants.name: alert
variants.title: Alert
variants.description: A red radar with a quick sweep and rings, for when something needs attention.

name: security-checkpoint
title: Security Checkpoint
description: A browser-verification card with lines that draw in from the side; the blocked ones stop at the card with a glowing dot. Draws instantly under reduced motion.

name: status-dot
title: Status Dot
description: A pill with a pulsing status dot and a label for service states: online, offline, maintenance or degraded.

name: unlock-face-id
title: Unlock Face ID
description: A Face ID style unlock: brackets and a face draw themselves, a scan line sweeps, then a check reveals the blurred content behind it. Controlled or self-running.

name: ai-message
title: AI Message
description: A chat message bubble for a user or an assistant, with copy, retry and thumbs buttons that appear on hover and on keyboard focus.

name: ai-prompt-input
title: AI Prompt Input
description: A chat prompt box that grows with the text. Enter sends, Shift+Enter adds a line, and the send button turns into a stop button while the model answers.

name: ai-sources
title: AI Sources
description: A "Used N sources" toggle that opens into a numbered list of links, for showing where an answer came from.

name: ai-suggestions
title: AI Suggestions
description: Prompt suggestion chips for an empty chat or the follow-ups after an answer. They pop in from the middle outward.

name: ai-typing-indicator
title: AI Typing Indicator
description: Three bouncing dots in a chat bubble that show someone is typing. Level and calm under reduced motion.

name: ai-reasoning
title: AI Reasoning
description: A collapsible reasoning trace. The summary shimmers only while the model is working, then settles, reports how long it took and folds away.

variants.name: streaming
variants.title: Streaming
variants.description: Open and shimmering while the model is still reasoning.

variants.name: collapsed
variants.title: Collapsed
variants.description: A finished trace folded down to its one-line summary.

name: ai-context-meter
title: AI Context Meter
description: A small ring and token count for the model's context window. The ring changes color near the limit, and a popover lists what fills it.

name: ai-task-list
title: AI Task List
description: The plan an agent is working through: rows with pending, running, done and failed states, sub-steps, and a done/total count worked out from the rows.

name: ai-tool-approval
title: AI Tool Approval
description: A card where the user approves or denies an agent's tool call, showing the command or fields, the reason, and a polite live announcement of the decision.

variants.name: approved
variants.title: Approved
variants.description: The settled state after the reader approves the command.

props.title: Run a command
props.reason: Check the checkout tests before changing the form.

variants.name: denied
variants.title: Denied
variants.description: The settled state after the reader denies a risky command.

props.title: Run a command
props.reason: Clear the stale build cache, then rebuild.

variants.name: field-list
variants.title: Field list
variants.description: A structured call whose input shows as labelled fields instead of a command.

props.title: Write a file
props.reason: Apply the validation fix to the checkout form.

name: ai-tool-call
title: AI Tool Call
description: One agent tool call as a single line with a status ring that turns from queued to running to done or failed. Opens to show arguments and result.

name: ai-orb
title: AI Orb
description: A soft glowing orb for a voice assistant with four states: idle, listening, thinking and speaking. Still and calm under reduced motion.

name: ai-voice-wave
title: AI Voice Wave
description: A row of bars for voice input or output. Feed it live levels or let it pulse on its own while active. Static and level-shaped under reduced motion.

name: bar-chart
title: Bar Chart
description: A vertical bar chart made of plain divs. The tallest bar is highlighted, values show on hover or all the time, and the full data is read aloud.

name: donut-chart
title: Donut Chart
description: A donut chart in plain SVG that draws in slice by slice. The legend gives every share as text, and the total sits in the hole.

name: heatmap-calendar
title: Heatmap Calendar
description: A contribution-style grid of days in weekly columns, darker for busier days. Hover or focus a day to read it; the total is the caption.

name: sparkline
title: Sparkline
description: A tiny line chart with no axes for rows, cards and tables. Plain SVG, optional area and end dot, with a spoken summary of the range.

name: kpi-card
title: KPI Card
description: A metric card with a label, a big number, the change since last period and an optional sparkline. Good and bad changes are colored and also spoken.

name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: A sortable table with real table markup. Click a heading to sort ascending, descending, then back to the original order. Numbers sort as numbers.

name: uptime-card
title: Uptime Card
description: A status card with a row of daily bars per service, an uptime percentage and a short list of recent incidents. Bars are readable by screen readers and inspectable with the keyboard.

variants.name: two-weeks
variants.title: Two weeks
variants.description: Fourteen wide bars per service for a short, readable window.

variants.name: ninety-days
variants.title: Ninety days
variants.description: A dense strip of ninety thin bars for a long history.

name: comparison-slider
title: Comparison Slider
description: A before/after reveal split by a draggable divider that is also a keyboard slider (arrows, page keys, home and end).

name: android-mockup
title: Android Mockup
description: A phone frame with a punch-hole camera and a gesture bar, drawn with theme tokens. Anything you pass becomes the screen.

name: iphone-mockup
title: iPhone Mockup
description: A phone frame with a dynamic island and side buttons, drawn with theme tokens. Anything you pass becomes the screen.

name: laptop-mockup
title: Laptop Mockup
description: A laptop with a 16:10 screen and a hinged base, drawn with theme tokens. Anything you pass becomes the screen.

name: safari-mockup
title: Safari Mockup
description: A browser window with traffic lights, toolbar icons and an address pill, drawn with theme tokens around any content.

name: terminal
title: Terminal
description: A terminal window that plays its lines in sequence: typed commands and fading output. Shows everything at once under reduced motion.

variants.name: parallel
variants.title: Parallel lines
variants.description: Lines run on their own delays instead of waiting for the one before, so the output lands almost at once.

name: audio-equalizer
title: Audio Equalizer
description: Level bars that bounce while audio plays and settle into a calm wave when it stops or when motion is reduced.

name: audio-player
title: Audio Player
description: A compact track card with cover, play and pause, a seek slider with times and a mute toggle. It runs its own clock, so it needs no audio file.

name: video-player-ui
title: Video Player UI
description: Video controls on a 16:9 stage: a big play button, scrub bar, time readout, speed cycle and fullscreen. It runs its own clock and loads no media.

name: candlestick-chart
title: Candlestick Chart
description: OHLC candles with volume bars, a last-price line and a keyboard-friendly crosshair readout, drawn in plain SVG.

name: depth-chart
title: Depth Chart
description: Cumulative buy and sell depth as two stepped areas meeting at the spread, with a keyboard-operable level readout, in plain SVG.

name: liquidity-heatmap
title: Liquidity Heatmap
description: Resting liquidity by price level over time as a grid of cells whose strength follows the size, with a current-price row and an arrow-key readout.

name: order-book
title: Order Book
description: A depth ladder with asks above and bids below, cumulative depth bars, a spread bar and a fill-cost readout on hover. Driven by snapshots passed as props.

variants.name: top-of-book
variants.title: Top of book
variants.description: Only the three nearest levels on each side, for a compact ticket.

name: prediction-market-bar
title: Prediction Market Bar
description: A binary market card: the question, the chance of Yes, a split odds bar and Yes and No share prices as buttons. Data in, no wallet.

name: price-target-fan
title: Price Target Fan
description: Recent price history followed by a cone from the low to the high target, with the average as a dashed line and the move against today's price.

name: price-ticker
title: Price Ticker
description: A price that rolls its digits on every update, flashes green or red, and shows a percent change badge.

variants.name: falling
variants.title: Falling
variants.description: A price below its 24h open, so the change badge reads as a loss.

variants.name: price-only
variants.title: Price only
variants.description: Just the rolling digits, with the change badge hidden.

name: volume-profile
title: Volume Profile
description: Volume traded at each price level as horizontal bars, with the point of control, value area and an inspect-by-keyboard readout, in plain SVG.

name: address-chip
title: Address Chip
description: A compact EVM address with a generated blockie-style avatar, copy button, ENS label and explorer link.

variants.name: bare
variants.title: Bare
variants.description: Only the shortened address as plain text, with no avatar and no copy button.

name: wallet-card
title: Wallet Card
description: A stack of payment-style cards with a pointer sheen: pick one to bring it forward, mask the balance and see who shares it.

name: currency-transfer
title: Currency Transfer
description: A transfer receipt that follows money through four steps, rolls the amount into the new currency and offers a copyable reference.

name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt Printer
description: A transaction receipt (hash, from, to, amount, fee, status) that feeds out of a printer slot one line at a time, with a serrated edge.

variants.name: manual-print
variants.title: Manual print
variants.description: The paper stays in the printer until the Print button is pressed.

variants.name: failed
variants.title: Failed
variants.description: A receipt for a transaction that failed on chain.

name: swap-panel
title: Swap Panel
description: A cross-chain swap ticket: pay and receive fields, a token picker with chain filter, a live quote and an optional destination address.

name: tx-steps
title: Transaction Steps
description: Step-by-step transaction status (Approve, Sign, Broadcast, Confirmed) with a spinning active step, checkmarks and error state.

variants.name: vertical
variants.title: Vertical
variants.description: The steps stacked in a column with a connecting line, mid-swap.

steps.label: Approve
steps.description: Allow the router to spend USDC

steps.label: Sign
steps.description: Confirm the swap in your wallet

variants.name: failed
variants.title: Failed step
variants.description: A row of steps where the wallet rejection stops the flow on an error state.

steps.label: Approve
steps.description: Allow the router to spend USDC

name: amount-pad
title: Amount Pad
description: A number pad for entering a token amount: animated digits, presets, a per-transfer cap, shake on refusal and physical keyboard input.

variants.name: dollar-prefix
variants.title: Dollar prefix
variants.description: A currency pad with the symbol in front of the amount and two decimals.

variants.name: whole-units
variants.title: Whole units
variants.description: A whole-number pad with no decimal key, for tokens that are not divisible.

name: amount-stepper
title: Amount Stepper
description: Minus, amount and plus in one inline control: decimal steps, min and max, and a ticker label for token amounts.

name: navbar-announce
title: Navbar Announcement
description: A dismissible announcement strip above a bar whose links share one soft highlight that glides between them.

name: navbar-fixed
title: Navbar Fixed
description: Full-width top bar that sticks or pins to the viewport, with links, a quiet action and a filled call to action.

name: navbar-floating
title: Navbar Floating
description: A rounded pill nav that floats inset from the top with a blurred backdrop and a call to action, easing in on mount.

name: navbar-mega
title: Navbar Mega Menu
description: Top bar with full-width mega-menu panels and its own focus management: arrow keys, Escape and click-away all behave.

name: navbar-mobile
title: Navbar Mobile Menu
description: Top bar that folds into a menu button on narrow containers, with focus moved into the open menu, a Tab loop and Escape to close.

name: hero-aurora-center
title: Hero Aurora Center
description: Full-bleed hero on a drifting aurora with a glass strip of three highlights along the bottom.

name: hero-dashboard-peek
title: Hero Dashboard Peek
description: Centered hero with an announcement pill whose product dashboard rises from the bottom edge and fades under the fold.

name: hero-email-waitlist
title: Hero Email Waitlist
description: Centered waitlist hero with one email field, inline validation and a thank-you state.

name: hero-giant-type
title: Hero Giant Type
description: Typographic hero: oversized words rise line by line, with a services list and a call to action below.

name: hero-logo-cloud
title: Hero Logo Cloud
description: Inverted hero panel with a centered headline, two buttons and a row of customer logos along the bottom.

name: hero-phone-split
title: Hero Phone Split
description: Split hero with copy and buttons beside a phone mock-up that carries two softly floating cards.

name: hero-prompt-card
title: Hero Prompt Card
description: Centered hero with a live prompt card: pick a project type and the brief underneath rewrites itself.

name: hero-section
title: Hero Section
description: Landing hero with an eyebrow pill, headline, copy, two calls to action and an optional media slot, revealed in a soft stagger.

name: hero-stat-strip
title: Hero Stat Strip
description: Left-aligned hero with a column of counting figures on the right, split by hairlines.

name: hero-store-badges
title: Hero Store Badges
description: App-download hero with a social proof pill, a huge two-line headline and store buttons on a warm glow.

name: hero-terminal-install
title: Hero Terminal Install
description: Developer hero with a copyable install command beside a terminal that plays the install.

name: logos-grid
title: Logos Grid
description: Logos in a ruled grid where each gets its own bordered cell that brightens on hover; cells can be links.

name: logos-marquee
title: Logos Marquee
description: A heading over an endless strip of logos that fades at both edges and pauses on hover. Still under reduced motion.

name: logos-row
title: Logos Row
description: A single quiet line: a label, a hairline rule and a row of logos that wraps on narrow containers.

name: logos-split
title: Logos Split
description: Headline, copy and a link on the left, logos as bordered tiles on the right; stacks on narrow containers.

name: features-accordion-media
title: Features Accordion Media
description: An accordion of features beside a preview panel that cross-fades to match the open row.

name: features-alternating
title: Features Alternating
description: Zig-zag rows with copy on one side and media on the other, swapping sides down the page.

name: features-bento
title: Features Bento
description: A headline beside its intro copy, over a dense bento grid of feature tiles with artwork.

name: features-checklist
title: Features Checklist
description: Copy and a call to action beside a two-column list of included capabilities, in one rounded panel.

name: features-comparison
title: Features Comparison
description: A real table that compares products or plans feature by feature, with check and cross marks and one highlighted column.

name: features-hover-expand
title: Features Hover Expand
description: A row of panels where the one you point at, focus or select grows to reveal its copy.

name: features-icon-grid
title: Features Icon Grid
description: A headline over a responsive grid of icon cards that rise in one after another.

name: features-integrations-beam
title: Features Integrations Beam
description: Copy beside a hub diagram where beams of light connect tools on both sides to your product.

name: features-marquee
title: Features Marquee
description: Rows of small feature chips that drift in alternating directions under a centered headline.

name: features-metrics-beam
title: Features Metrics Beam
description: A lead metric card ringed by a travelling light, with the remaining proof points stacked beside it.

name: features-numbered
title: Features Numbered
description: Editorial columns without cards: a rule, an oversized numeral, a title and a line of copy.

name: features-showcase
title: Features Showcase
description: A product shot in the middle with feature callouts on both sides, stacking under it on narrow containers.

name: features-steps
title: Features Steps
description: A numbered vertical timeline: a sticky headline on one side, steps joined by a rail on the other.

name: features-sticky-list
title: Features Sticky List
description: A headline that stays pinned while tall feature cards with visuals scroll past it.

name: features-tabs
title: Features Tabs
description: Pill tabs where each tab opens a panel with copy, bullets and a visual that slides in from the side you move towards.

name: features-terminal
title: Features Terminal
description: A feature list beside a terminal that types a command and prints the result.

name: stats-band
title: Stats Band
description: A single filled strip of counting stats separated by hairlines, made to sit between two sections.

name: stats-editorial-list
title: Stats Editorial List
description: Oversized numbers in ruled rows, each with its explanation beside it, like a magazine spread.

name: stats-grid
title: Stats Grid
description: A centered headline over a grid of cards, each with a big number that counts up as it scrolls into view.

name: stats-progress-bars
title: Stats Progress Bars
description: A headline beside a stack of labelled bars that fill to their percentage as they scroll into view.

name: stats-sparkline-cards
title: Stats Sparkline Cards
description: Cards that pair a counting number with a small line chart of its recent history that draws itself in.

name: stats-split-feature
title: Stats Split Feature
description: The story and a link on the left, a two by two grid of ruled, counting stats on the right.

name: stats-trend-cards
title: Stats Trend Cards
description: Left-aligned metric cards with a corner icon, a counting number and a green or red change chip.

name: testimonial-carousel
title: Testimonial Carousel
description: One testimonial at a time with previous and next buttons, dots, a counter and arrow keys. No autoplay.

name: testimonial-chat
title: Testimonial Chat
description: Testimonials as a chat thread: bubbles on alternating sides with initials avatars, revealed in a soft stagger.

name: testimonial-featured
title: Testimonial Featured
description: One large centered quote with its author, backed by a row of shorter supporting quotes.

name: testimonial-marquee
title: Testimonial Marquee
description: Rows of testimonial cards drifting in opposite directions with faded edges. Built on Marquee; still under reduced motion.

name: testimonial-metrics
title: Testimonial Metrics
description: Cards that lead with one big result and back it up with a short quote and author.

name: testimonial-spotlight
title: Testimonial Spotlight
description: A row of initials avatars; the one you pick takes the spotlight with a large quote.

name: testimonial-stack
title: Testimonial Stack
description: A pile of testimonial cards; Next sends the top card to the back and brings up the one behind it.

name: testimonial-vertical-marquee
title: Testimonial Vertical Marquee
description: Columns of testimonial cards scrolling up and down inside a masked window. Built on Marquee; still under reduced motion.

name: testimonial-wall
title: Testimonial Wall
description: Masonry wall of testimonial cards in one to three columns with optional star ratings and initials avatars.

name: pricing-addons-builder
title: Pricing Add-ons Builder
description: A base plan plus checkable add-ons, with a receipt panel that sums the monthly total.

name: pricing-comparison-table
title: Pricing Comparison Table
description: A feature matrix with plans as columns and grouped features as rows; the recommended plan's column is tinted.

name: pricing-credit-packs
title: Pricing Credit Packs
description: Prepaid credit packs as selectable tiles with a summary bar showing the price per credit.

name: pricing-enterprise-split
title: Pricing Enterprise Split
description: Quick self-serve plans on one side and a dark talk-to-sales card on the other.

name: pricing-lifetime-deal
title: Pricing Lifetime Deal
description: A one-time-payment offer as a ticket-style card with a price stub and a bar for licences left.

name: pricing-plan-list
title: Pricing Plan List
description: Plans as selectable rows with a summary panel that follows the choice and a button to continue.

name: pricing-single-card
title: Pricing Single Card
description: One plan in a single card with a monthly / yearly switch and a price that ticks between the two.

name: pricing-tier-cards
title: Pricing Tier Cards
description: Three side-by-side tier cards with a billing switch; the featured tier sits raised with a badge.

name: pricing-usage-slider
title: Pricing Usage Slider
